F14-3 Busway run from switchboard B2-DH3-MSB-A1 to UPS-A1: joints, tap-off units and the test points

2500 A aluminium busway, 46 m, 12 straight lengths and 11 joints · torque each joint to the OEM value and mark it · joint resistance by DLRO at 100 A · IR 1000 V DC phase to phase and phase to earth, ≥ 1 MΩ OEM minimum (Canalis KR guide)
• Joint J7 reads 31 µΩ against 14 to 17 µΩ for the other joints: more than 50 % above the lowest value (14 µΩ), so it is opened, cleaned, re-torqued and measured again.
• Insulation resistance of the complete run: 1,850 MΩ phase to earth at 1000 V DC, above the 1 MΩ minimum in the OEM guide and the 100 MΩ value used from NETA Table 100.1.
